title: Impressive in the beginning!
text:
Impressive in the beginning!. I bought a corded vac similar design to this Rechargeable one, thinking it would be more powerful- I was wrong.

I am amazed at the section power of this machine- it far out performs the corded one. I like that there are 3 speeds and even the lowest is better than the corded machine.
It’s not too loud and really picks up dust and other bits and pieces. Charging light is easy to see and switching power levels is right at the handle at your fingertip. Easy to empty the dust cup.

So far the battery life seems good. I will review after a few more uses.

So happy with this and I recommend.

Update: changed my review from 5 to 3 stars. (should have been submitted since around July) the vacuum has stopped powering on. The battery shows charging and fully charged but no response when the power button is pressed. So it’s no use. So disappointing!
